name: Richard Moll
bio: Richard Moll (January 13, 1943 - October 26, 2023) was born in Pasadena, California, USA as Charles Richard Moll. He was an actor, known for Scary Movie 2 (2001), But I'm a Cheerleader (1999), The Flintstones (1994), and the television series Night Court. He was previously married to Susan Brown and Laura Class.
